list.title: Members
list.description: {count, plural, one {# member} other {# members}} matching the current filters
list.caption: Members
list.emptyBody: Invite the people who work in the laboratory. Each gets a one-time link to choose a password.
list.noMatchBody: Try a different search, or clear the filters to see everyone.

invite.title: Invite a member
invite.description: They receive a one-time link to choose a password. There is no public sign-up.
invite.readyDescription: Share the link below. It is shown only once.
invite.name: Username
invite.nameHint: How they will sign in. 2 to 40 letters, numbers, spaces, dots, dashes or underscores.
invite.nameInvalid: Use 2 to 40 letters, numbers, spaces, dots, dashes or underscores.
invite.roleMemberHint: Works on the experiments they are assigned to.
invite.roleAdminHint: Full access: members, organizations, locations, shipments, holds and reports. Two-step verification is required.

link.intro: Share this link with {name}. It can be used once and expires on {expires}. It is not shown again, but you can issue a new link at any time.
link.fieldHint: Anyone with this link can set the password for this account.
link.copiedAnnouncement: Invitation link copied to the clipboard.
link.copyFailed: The link could not be copied automatically. Select the text in the field and copy it.

actions.reasonHint: At least 10 characters. The reason is kept in the audit trail.

reissue.title: Issue a new link for {name}?
reissue.body: The previous link stops working. The new link is shown once.
reissue.linkDescription: Share the link below. The previous one no longer works.

revoke.title: Revoke the invitation for {name}?
revoke.body: The link stops working and the pending account is removed. The revocation is recorded in the audit trail.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {name}?
deactivate.body: They are signed out everywhere and can no longer sign in. Their records and audit history are kept, and you can reactivate them later.

reactivate.title: Reactivate {name}?
reactivate.body: They can sign in again with their existing password.

reset-mfa.title: Reset two-step verification for {name}?
reset-mfa.body: Their authenticator and recovery codes are removed and they are signed out. They set up a new authenticator at next sign-in.

pseudonymise.title: Erase the personal data of {name}?
pseudonymise.body: The e-mail address, password, two-step verification, sessions and name are removed from the account, which becomes a numbered former member. Audit entries and regulated records keep the name as it was written at the time. This cannot be undone.

security.title: Security
security.description: Visible to administrators and to the member.

experiments.title: {count, plural, one {# experiment} other {# experiments}}
experiments.caption: Experiments this member belongs to
experiments.emptyBody: Add this member from an experiment's page.

activity.title: Recent activity
activity.description: The latest recorded actions by this member, from the audit trail.
